blocks.x: Case processing down 52% — document intelligence under accountable-AI gates
A national digital-government agency — Public Sector & Government engagement delivered by a 24-person team over 17 months, EU scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Permits and benefit files paper-shaped; backlogs measured in months.
AI proposals blocked by accountability gaps; no oversight framework.
Agency data islands prevented tell-us-once services.

blocks.x: Casework agents assemble evidence with officer-approval gates; every AI-assisted decision carries transparency notices, human oversight and Compass-generated conformity documentation mapped to the EU AI Act; the interagency exchange (consent-aware, event-driven) enabled tell-us-once across four agencies.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.

items: OEE +7.2 points across 14 plants — sensor fabric to scheduling decisions
Yield +2.8 points, recalls scoped in minutes — quality and traceability program

blocks.x: Towers: Applied AI & Generative AI, Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse. Platforms: Achala Swarm, Achala Compass, Achala Forge.

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
the baseline numbers and the client's specific regulatory posture — your program starts with its own locked baseline.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
